# Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

I couldn't open the retailer pages, so prices come from the review sites and change often. Check the final price at checkout.

## Top picks

**Best overall: Nothing Ear (3), just under $150 on Amazon**
- SoundGuys scored its noise cancelling 8.2/10. It has LDAC, multipoint, wireless charging and IP54 water resistance.
- Downsides: bass-heavy tuning, muffled call mics, and about 5 hours per charge with ANC on.
- [Buy on Amazon, per iTech Level's list](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/) | [SlashGear's roundup](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

**Best for Android: Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro, about $134 on Amazon (Samsung's official store)**
- SlashGear calls the ANC great. Battery is up to 18 hours with the case, and they're IPX7-rated.
- They're built for Samsung phones but work with other Android devices.
- [SlashGear's roundup](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

**Best for iPhone: AirPods Pro 2 (previous generation), around $150 or less on sale**
- SlashGear says the ANC and transparency mode are still excellent. Apple no longer sells them new, so you'd buy renewed or from other retailers.
- [SlashGear's roundup](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

**Best value: Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro, $149.99 list**
- SoundGuys rated it 8.2/10. It has LDAC, multipoint, wireless charging and IPX5 resistance, and it's often discounted.
- Dealectric reports $120 with code AFSC20 at Soundcore's US store (tested 2026-10-22). It's an affiliate link, and the store's checkout has the final word: [Buy at Soundcore](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-liberty-4-pro)
- The newer Liberty 5 Pro is RTINGS' best mid-range pick, but it's $169.99, over your budget.
- [iTech Level's list](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/) | [Dealectric page](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-liberty-4-pro)

## Cheaper options

- **Sony WF-C710N, about $119–$128:** What Hi-Fi's best budget pick. Sony's ANC and app, 8.5 hours per charge, but no LDAC. [What Hi-Fi guide](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise)
- **Anker Soundcore Space A40:** RTINGS' best budget ANC pick. It has strong adaptive ANC and LDAC, but poor call mics. I didn't see a price. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds)
- **Soundcore P31i, $59.99:** Good ANC for the money, with a 4.4-star average on Amazon. [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)
- **EarFun Air Pro 4:** Soundmavericks' top pick, with a strong spec sheet and good ANC. That list relies on specs and other labs' data rather than hands-on testing, and I didn't see a price. [Soundmavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/)

## How to choose
- **iPhone:** AirPods Pro 2.
- **Samsung or other Android:** Galaxy Buds3 Pro, or Nothing Ear (3) if you want LDAC.
- **Best sound and ANC for the money:** Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro, especially with the code.
- **Tightest budget:** Sony WF-C710N or Soundcore P31i.

The best ANC overall (Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds 2nd Gen at $299, Sony WF-1000XM6) costs well over $150.
